description: Sacramento, CA — Nevada County Supervisor Robb Tucker, a lifelong resident of California’s newly drawn Congressional District 3, announced his candidacy last month and has already secured a wave of support from community members, elected officials, business owners, and grassroots leaders across the region. In a rare show of unity, Tucker has received unanimous endorsements…
